author: blakki
quote: Has nothing to do with GTA and by far the worst game of the franchise... this is more like a real life simulator than a grand theft auto game. You gotta fill up your car with gas, pay road tolls, feed your pets and all kinds of boring stuff... Meanwhile you can't even steal all cars for example and ever worse, not even save stolen cars or weapons at your crib. Lame story, extremly boring and bad writing, disappointing characters and toooooo many restrictions to what woulf make this game fun. Absolute flop
